description: Compare Faisal Heights in Faisal Town Phase 1 with Faisal Jewel in Faisal Hills, including location, property types and buyer considerations.
intro:
Faisal Heights and Faisal Jewel are both high-rise projects associated with FaisalTown Group, but they are not the same project and are not located in the same development.

Faisal Heights is located in Faisal Town Phase 1, Block C, while Faisal Jewel is associated with the Executive Block of Faisal Hills. This guide explains the difference before comparing either project with residential plots in Faisal Town.
body:
## Faisal Jewel and Faisal Heights at a glance

Faisal Jewel and Faisal Heights are separate high-rise developments associated with FaisalTown Group.

The most important difference is location.

Faisal Heights is positioned within Faisal Town Phase 1, Block C.

Faisal Jewel is associated with the Executive Block of Faisal Hills rather than Faisal Town Phase 1 or Phase 2.

Both therefore belong to the wider FaisalTown Group project portfolio, but buyers should not treat them as two buildings inside the same housing project.

## Quick comparison

| Feature | Faisal Heights | Faisal Jewel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Developer / Group | FaisalTown Group | FaisalTown Group |
| Project Type | Residential high-rise | Residential and commercial high-rise |
| Location | Faisal Town Phase 1, Block C | Executive Block, Faisal Hills |
| Main Property Types | Studios, apartments and lofts | Apartments, penthouses and commercial units |
| Plotted Residential Project? | No | No |
| Separate From Faisal Town Phase 2? | Yes | Yes |
| Buyer Focus | Apartment living / investment | Residential, commercial and mixed-use investment |

Always verify current inventory, payment terms and construction status before booking.

## What is Faisal Heights?

Faisal Heights is a high-rise residential development located in Faisal Town Phase 1, Block C.

FaisalTown Group describes the project as a premium residential venture located near Srinagar Highway and the wider Faisal Town Phase 1 road network.

Current official project material describes four interconnected residential towers with apartment options ranging from studios through larger multi-bedroom units and loft-style residences.

This makes Faisal Heights a very different property product from buying a residential plot in Block A, B or C.

With an apartment purchase, the buyer is primarily evaluating:

- apartment size
- floor
- view and orientation
- building facilities
- parking
- payment schedule
- construction status
- handover expectations
- maintenance and service charges

A residential plot buyer has a different set of concerns such as road width, plot dimensions, street location and future construction.

## Where is Faisal Heights located?

Current FaisalTown Group material places Faisal Heights in Block C of Faisal Town Phase 1.

The project is also described in relation to Srinagar Highway, the M-1 Motorway area and Faisal Town Phase 1 access.

This location is important because Faisal Heights should not be confused with Faisal Town Phase 2.

If a third-party page labels Faisal Heights as a Phase 2 project, compare that claim with the developer's current project documentation before relying on it.

For this website, the developer's current description should take priority: Faisal Heights is treated as a Faisal Town Phase 1 / Block C high-rise project.

## Faisal Heights apartment types

Current FaisalTown Group material includes a broad range of residential configurations.

These include:

- studio apartments
- 1-bedroom apartments
- 2-bedroom apartments
- 3-bedroom apartments
- 4-bedroom apartments
- loft-style units

Current official material also describes more than 700 residential units across four towers.

Exact unit size, floor, price and payment schedule should be checked against current inventory rather than assumed from an old brochure.

## Faisal Heights construction status

FaisalTown Group currently describes Faisal Heights as under construction.

Development updates published by the developer have documented excavation, steel delivery and site construction progress.

Because construction status changes over time, buyers should request the latest dated progress update before booking or purchasing a resale allocation.

Useful checks include:

- current construction stage
- tower being offered
- apartment number
- expected handover
- amount already paid
- remaining payment schedule
- transfer eligibility

Do not rely on an old launch video as evidence of today's construction position.

## What is Faisal Jewel?

Faisal Jewel is another high-rise development associated with FaisalTown Group, but it should not be confused with Faisal Heights.

The official project name is Faisal Jewel, singular.

Current project material places Faisal Jewel in the Executive Block of Faisal Hills.

It is therefore part of the wider Faisal Hills project environment rather than Faisal Town Phase 1 or Faisal Town Phase 2.

## Where is Faisal Jewel located?

Current Faisal Jewel project material identifies the location as the Executive Block of Faisal Hills, Rawalpindi.

That means someone searching Faisal Town Islamabad plots should not interpret Faisal Jewel as another sector or block of Faisal Town.

It is a separate high-rise product within the FaisalTown Group portfolio.

Buyers should verify the exact project entrance, tower, unit and site location before making a payment.

## Faisal Jewel property types

Faisal Jewel combines residential and commercial components.

Current project-focused material describes:

- studio apartments
- 1-bedroom apartments
- 2-bedroom apartments
- 3-bedroom apartments
- 4-bedroom apartments
- penthouses
- commercial shops or units

This mixed-use structure creates a different buyer profile from a purely plotted residential project.

A residential apartment buyer may focus on living space and building amenities, while a commercial buyer may focus more on footfall, floor position, visibility and rental potential.

## Faisal Jewel residential vs commercial units

Residential and commercial units should not be compared only by price per square foot.

Residential buyers should consider:

- apartment layout
- floor
- view
- parking
- amenities
- service charges
- handover
- rental audience

Commercial buyers should also evaluate:

- unit frontage
- floor level
- access
- surrounding retail mix
- expected footfall
- lease potential
- building occupancy

The investment case can therefore differ significantly even within the same project.

## Faisal Heights vs Faisal Jewel

The two projects serve overlapping but not identical buyer needs.

Faisal Heights is primarily positioned as a residential high-rise inside Faisal Town Phase 1.

Faisal Jewel combines residential and commercial high-rise opportunities in Faisal Hills.

A buyer comparing the two should consider:

- project location
- residential vs mixed-use focus
- apartment size
- construction status
- payment schedule
- expected handover
- commercial component
- parking
- service charges
- intended use

Location should be compared before price because the projects sit in different developments.

## High-rise apartment vs Faisal Town plot

A high-rise apartment and a residential plot are fundamentally different property products.

### Residential plot

A plot buyer usually considers:

- land ownership
- plot size
- street location
- road width
- possession
- construction timeline
- surrounding development
- ability to build a custom house

### High-rise unit

An apartment or high-rise buyer typically considers:

- covered area
- floor
- view
- building completion
- parking
- elevators
- common areas
- building management
- service charges
- handover
- rental demand

Comparing a 5-marla plot with an apartment only by total price is therefore not meaningful.

## Which may suit an end user?

A residential plot may suit someone who wants to build a custom family home and control the design and construction process.

A high-rise apartment may suit someone who prefers:

- lower construction responsibility
- managed building facilities
- security
- elevators
- apartment-style living
- easier lock-and-leave use

The better choice depends on lifestyle rather than simply investment return.

## Which may suit an investor?

An investor should compare cash flow, entry price, construction stage and resale market rather than relying on branding.

For a high-rise project, consider:

- purchase price
- payment schedule
- construction risk
- handover period
- rental yield potential
- service charges
- resale liquidity

For a residential plot, consider:

- development
- possession
- location
- comparable plot prices
- construction activity
- resale demand
- holding period

Neither product automatically offers better returns.

## Payment-plan checks

High-rise projects commonly use staged payment schedules.

Before booking Faisal Heights or Faisal Jewel, request a current written schedule showing:

- total unit price
- booking amount
- down payment
- installment frequency
- remaining balance
- construction-linked payments
- possession payment
- development or documentation charges
- transfer charges
- applicable discount

Do not use a payment plan from one project to estimate the other.

## Construction and possession checks

Before buying into an under-construction building, ask for the latest dated construction information.

Confirm:

- tower or building
- apartment or unit number
- floor
- current construction stage
- expected completion
- expected possession
- paid amount
- outstanding balance
- transfer procedure

If buying a resale allocation, verify the payment ledger directly rather than relying only on the seller's summary.

## NOC and regulatory verification

Regulatory and approval claims should be independently verified before payment.

A marketing website or dealer page should not be the only source used for an NOC decision.

Ask for:

- current approval documentation
- relevant authority reference
- approved project name
- approved site or building details
- current developer documentation

Check that the approval relates to the exact project being offered rather than another FaisalTown Group development.

## Service charges and building costs

Apartment buyers should ask about costs that plot buyers normally do not face.

These may include:

- monthly maintenance
- elevator maintenance
- security
- common-area electricity
- backup power
- parking charges
- facility charges
- building insurance or management costs

These ongoing expenses affect the true cost of owning a high-rise unit.

## Rental potential

High-rise apartments may appeal to buyers seeking rental income, but projected rent should be treated cautiously until the building is completed and occupied.

Ask:

- who the expected tenant is
- comparable rents nearby
- likely occupancy
- furnishing cost
- service charges
- management fees
- parking availability

Do not treat an advertised rental yield as guaranteed.

## What to verify before booking

Before making a substantial payment for either project:

1. Confirm the exact project.
2. Confirm the developer documentation.
3. Verify the location.
4. Confirm the tower or building.
5. Confirm the unit number.
6. Review the floor plan.
7. Check the total price.
8. Obtain the current payment schedule.
9. Verify construction progress.
10. Check transfer rules.
11. Confirm service charges.
12. Review current approval documentation.
13. Obtain official payment and receipt instructions.

These checks are more useful than comparing the two projects only by advertised price.

## Faisal Heights, Faisal Jewel or a residential plot?

The answer depends on what you want to own.

Choose a Faisal Town residential plot if your priority is land ownership, building a house or purchasing established Phase 1 resale property.

Consider Faisal Heights if your interest is apartment living or high-rise residential investment within Faisal Town Phase 1.

Consider Faisal Jewel separately if you are evaluating a residential or commercial high-rise opportunity in Faisal Hills.

The three options should be treated as different property categories rather than interchangeable investments.
